target.description: End of the established hot-flame phase after the cutoff: cumulative                           incidence of spontaneous extinction and of operator termination, the                           probability of still being active, and the mass left at the model                           horizon, under the observed experimental policy. The artifact is an                           event partition over forecast times (kind event_probabilities).
excludes: the counterfactual lifetime without the operator
flame size, temperature, radiant emission, soot or species
the other configuration (normal and inverse are never pooled)
a calibrated posterior: the probabilities follow from handwritten hazards

features.name: c_logm
features.transform: ln(x / norm.mdot_ref_kg_s); x is the injected OXIDISER mass flow (setpoint) @1

features.name: c_o2
features.transform: (x - norm.o2_ref) / norm.o2_scale; x is the O2 mole fraction of the INJECTED stream @1

features.name: c_xf
features.transform: ln(x / norm.xf_ref); x is the fuel mole fraction of the AMBIENT (chamber) gas @1

features.name: x_t
features.transform: ln(1 + t / norm.t_ref_s), t in seconds since the time origin @1

tensors.name: ext.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the spontaneous extinction network; row j reads x in feature order.

tensors.name: ext.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the spontaneous extinction network (hinge positions).

tensors.name: ext.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the spontaneous extinction network.

tensors.name: ext.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of ln(hazard) of spontaneous extinction in x; every element is stated.

tensors.name: ext.b0
tensors.description: ln(hazard * 1 s) of spontaneous extinction at x = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: op.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the operator termination network; row j reads x in feature order.

tensors.name: op.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the operator termination network (hinge positions).

tensors.name: op.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the operator termination network.

tensors.name: op.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of ln(hazard) of operator termination in x; every element is stated.

tensors.name: op.b0
tensors.description: ln(hazard * 1 s) of operator termination at x = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: norm.p_ref_pa
tensors.description: Reference pressure of c_logp.

tensors.name: norm.mdot_ref_kg_s
tensors.description: Reference injected mass flow of c_logm.

tensors.name: norm.o2_ref
tensors.description: Centre of c_o2.

tensors.name: norm.o2_scale
tensors.description: Scale of c_o2.

tensors.name: norm.xf_ref
tensors.description: Reference fuel fraction of c_xf.

tensors.name: norm.tad_ref_k
tensors.description: Centre of c_tad.

tensors.name: norm.tad_scale_k
tensors.description: Scale of c_tad.

tensors.name: norm.zst_ref
tensors.description: Centre of c_zst.

tensors.name: norm.zst_scale
tensors.description: Scale of c_zst.

tensors.name: norm.t_ref_s
tensors.description: Time scale of x_t = ln(1 + t / t_ref).

tensors.name: haz.log_cap
tensors.description: Upper clamp of each ln(hazard * 1 s) (numerical safety).

tensors.name: num.dt_s
tensors.description: Largest integration step; steps end exactly on forecast times.

tensors.name: num.horizon_s
tensors.description: Model horizon since the time origin; probability left there is unresolved_support.

notes: No time series enters: conditions, cutoff and control stages known at the cutoff only. Hazards are taken constant over each step at its midpoint; within a step the two causes share the lost mass in proportion to their hazards, so the four rows sum to one exactly. A stop known at the cutoff (control `scheduled_stop`, `flow_stop`, or an operator action starting `MFCs off`) at or before the cutoff refuses the forecast; a later one moves the mass still active at that time to operator_termination. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
